[LFST.7.2.4] **The engine supplies no key that joins two streams.** Tools
reconstructing whole-session behaviour align them by values the facts carry:
an author who needs a published fact recognised on both tiers declares an
identifying slot on its schema and fills it on the sending tier, and the value
crosses with the fact. An `event_id` is no such key ([LFST.5.6]). The
per-stream total order remains `seq`-only.
